items.heading: Usually a Third
items.text: Usually a third-party guarantee and no property. The credit guarantee scheme below can remove even the guarantee.

items.heading: No Security and No Margin
items.text: No Security and No Margin No security and no margin money (your own share of the fee). Banks are told not to ask for collateral at this size.

items.heading: The Bank Holds a Claim
items.text: The bank holds a claim on your asset until the loan is cleared.

items.heading: "Unsecured Means Nobody Has
items.text: "Unsecured means nobody has to repay if things go wrong." It does not. The co-borrower still owes the full amount.

items.heading: "Secured Is Always the Better
items.text: "Secured is always the better deal because the rate is lower." Sometimes the saving is small next to the risk to the asset.
